name: currency_converter
description: Convert an amount between real currencies using live exchange rates. Use this any time a currency conversion is asked for (e.g. 'convert 100 USD to NGN') — never estimate or invent an exchange rate from memory, rates change daily and a guessed number is a real hallucination risk.

from_currency.description: 3-letter currency code to convert from, e.g. 'USD', 'NGN', 'EUR'.
